causal_conclusion: The Phase 4 baseline did not evaluate the sealed LayerCake product core. It evaluated a distinct legacy ABI research host that has no usable autonomous behavior on the locked ABI suite. Training a capability artifact against that host would confound ABI acquisition with host-side English relearning and cannot certify product integration.
layercake_claim_boundary: This is an ABI host-selection and lineage failure, not a LayerCake regression. The separate LayerCake repository's sealed claims are unchanged and are not imported into ABI.
decision: Reject the legacy 61.7M host as the Phase 4 product host. Prohibit further training against it. Perform a read-only, hash-bound external handoff compatibility audit against the actual sealed LayerCake product identity and its construct-certified external-artifact interfaces before selecting one immutable host boundary.
claim_boundary: Phase 4 remains conditionally open and uncertified. No stable frontier, minimum information budget, runtime result, matched-baseline result, final-test result, or ABI-superiority claim is established.
